last_result.mechanism: V2.10c's list item #1 is 'ShiZi has a new instruction'. D1 (todo.md) and A2 ('continue') have no explicit new instruction -> it checked item #1, found nothing, and concluded 'I have nothing' without reaching item #2. The nine characters I deleted in wake1135 were exactly the guard against this.
last_result.main_finding: Not a bug fix - a bug swap. The phrase was both the disease (state words read as description) and the medicine (the constraint 'do not stop at item #1'). Deleting it fixed A1 and revived 'only check item #1'.
last_result.clause43_two_sided: Same sentence read two ways: the action words (jump/first/stop) are read as STATE (harmful); the negation is read as CONSTRAINT (useful). V2.10d removes the state words and keeps the constraint - it is the arm that should have been run.

new_clause.45: Any single-cell fix must be validated on the full matrix: the mechanism of a fix may simultaneously be the cause of another error. Fixing one cell and breaking three is not a bug fix, it is a bug swap. Decide whether to delete by how COMMON the error it was blocking is, not by how VISIBLE the error it was fixing is.
